verdict.rationale: Password-protecting a deployed site is a fair question for a hosting platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a built-in feature for it (basic auth, a password gate, or an access proxy). Secrets storage and org-level service access grants are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not site password protection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can put simple password protection on a deployed site without standing up a custom auth system
